notes: The competing reading folds the final *it* into מַשְׁבִּיר's own rendering, since the hiphil's lexeme is selling grain; it is marked `added` under rule 44 instead, no object morpheme standing in the clause and the pronoun being no part of the verb's own English word.
The possessive לְ is the verbless clause's predicate and takes the copula, heading on *upon* under rule 49.
